h:
这些工作流程针对以下方面进行了优化纳米混合，但它们与其他基于 Illustrious 的模型同样适用，例如八作, 詹库, 诺瓦, 和瓦伊- 所以请随意将它们与适合您风格的任何检查点一起使用！他们使用RealESRGAN-2x对于升级，可在舒适UI管理器或上开放模型数据库.

单角色工作流程：

的单角色工作流程完全使用 ComfyUI 的本机节点构建 —无需自定义节点。我将它们组织成干净、最小的节点组，以使事情变得简单，这样您就可以专注于提示，而不会陷入技术细节的困境。它们非常适合单角色生成和简单的构图。使用死亡之刺.肖像用于肖像和死亡之刺.壁纸壁纸。

多角色工作流程：

的多角色工作流程是为两个或更多角色设计的，而保持每个角色的独特性并且及时准确。他们用我的平铺注意情侣自定义节点并被组织成最小的节点组，以尽可能保持干净和用户友好。您可以从简单的两个字符设置开始，然后将其扩展为支持三个、四个或更多。使用死亡之刺.肖像.平铺用于肖像和死亡之刺.壁纸.平铺壁纸。

o.en:
These workflows are optimized forNanoMix, but they work equally well with other Illustrious-based models such asHassaku, Janku, Nova, andWAI— so feel free to use them with whatever checkpoint fits your style! They useRealESRGAN-2xfor upscaling, available in theComfyUI Manageror onOpenModelDB.

Single-Character Workflows:

Thesingle-character workflowsare built entirely with ComfyUI's native nodes —no custom nodes required. I’ve organized them into clean, minimal node groups to keep things simple, so you can focus on prompting without getting bogged down in technical details. They're ideal for single-character generations and straightforward compositions. UseDeathspike.Portraitfor portraits andDeathspike.Wallpaperfor wallpapers.

Multi-Character Workflows:

Themulti-character workflowsare designed for two or more characters, whilekeeping each character distinctand prompt-accurate. They use myTiled Attention Couplecustom node and are organized into minimal node groups to stay as clean and user-friendly as possible. You can start with a simple two-character setup, and then expand it to support three, four, ormore. UseDeathspike.Portrait.Tiledfor portraits andDeathspike.Wallpaper.Tiledfor wallpapers.
